restoration_note: This teaching describes the self's binding of the soul into the five faculty/body pairs (mind/bone, thought/sinew, teaching/vein, counsel/flesh, reflection/skin), the Lord's reversal of that binding faculty by faculty, the formation of the New Man with his five virtues (love, faith, perfection, patience, wisdom), and the analogy of the Mind of Light's hiddenness with the Watchers contracted in the Zone. The bulk of restorations are tightly constrained morphological completions across line-breaks (single letters or short fragments completing standard Manichaean cosmological vocabulary: ⲥⲱⲙⲁ, ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈, ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ, ⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ, ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ, ⲛⲓⲁⲛⲟⲩⲣ̄ⲱⲉ) confirmed by the editor and supported by the strict formulaic parallelism of this teaching (the 'releases X of soul / binds X of Sin' refrain; the ⲧⲍⲉ ⲁⲛ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲓ̈ analogical refrain). The unrecoverable gaps cluster in sections 2206-2213 (the soul's enmity to her father, what she put on, what the Lord cuts off) and in the long opening (2185-2188) where multiple plausible fillers compete with no decisive trace; honest non-restoration was preferred there. The Coptic gap {76} 'great Aeons of Greatness' (ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲋ) was restorable from the lexicon's stable corpus formula. The list of New Man's virtues (gap {55}) was restored as ⲡⲭⲱⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'perfection' since love, faith, patience, wisdom occupy the other four positions in the explicit pentad, and ⲡⲭⲱⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ recurs as the New Man's own virtue in the parallel 2255.
